value.rationale: The motivating 2026 quantum-walk work numerically observes postselected stationary entanglement at fixed six-spin size but does not quantify its survival in large-degree star networks. The exact m^-2 coefficients and sharp transition between hub–leaf and leaf–leaf dominance resolve a natural structural gap and reveal that pairwise entanglement vanishes even as the number of possible correlated leaf pairs rises quadratically.
